ios.desc:
touch grass

block your apps until you literally touch grass.

tired of mindless scrolling? touch grass helps you reclaim your time by blocking your most distracting apps until you connect with nature.

key features:
- block distracting apps until you verify touching grass
- smart grass detection using computer vision
- track your screen time progress
- flexible unblock durations for your lifestyle
- monthly free skip when you need it

premium features:
- block unlimited apps and categories
- view your screen time history
- deeper insights into your usage patterns

impact:
50% of all skip purchase profits support uk rewilding projects. reduce your screen time while helping restore natural habitats.

how it works:
1. choose apps to block
2. when you want to use them, take a photo of grass
3. enjoy your apps, knowing you've stepped outside

perfect for:
- breaking phone addiction
- building healthier habits
- finding balance with technology
- reconnecting with nature
- mindful tech usage

requirements:
- iphone running ios 17 or later
- a patch of grass (real ones only!)

touch grass: end the screen addiction.

terms of use: https://touchgrass.now/terms
